instruction: Rename file 'old.txt' to 'new.txt' in each of directories 'dir1', 'dir2', 'dir3'.

parameters.command: rm -rf dir1 dir2 dir3 && mkdir dir1 dir2 dir3 && echo 'Content 1' > dir1/old.txt && echo 'Content 2' > dir2/old.txt && echo 'Content 3' > dir3/old.txt

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'alt', 't'); time.sleep(0.5)

result.command: bash -c 'for d in dir1 dir2 dir3; do if [ -f "$d/new.txt" ] && [ ! -f "$d/old.txt" ]; then echo "Success: new.txt exists and old.txt removed in $d."; else echo "Failure: rename not completed in $d."; fi; done'

include: Success: new.txt exists and old.txt removed in dir1.
Success: new.txt exists and old.txt removed in dir2.
Success: new.txt exists and old.txt removed in dir3.
